hooks.command: input=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); marker="$HOME/.claude/state/askuserquestion-$sid.needs"; [ ! -f "$marker" ] && exit 0; tool=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); query=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.query // empty'); if [ "$tool" = "ToolSearch" ] && echo "$query" | grep -q 'select:AskUserQuestion'; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Call ToolSearch with query select:AskUserQuestion before any other tool this session. See ~/.claude/settings.json SessionStart hook.' >&2; exit 2

input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"gh pr create'; then git fetch origin main && BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) && if [ "$BEHIND" -gt 0 ]; then git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease origin "$(git branch --show-current)"; fi; fi

input=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); query=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.query // empty'); if echo "$query" | grep -q 'select:AskUserQuestion'; then rm -f "$HOME/.claude/state/askuserquestion-$sid.needs"; fi; exit 0

input=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/state"; [ -n "$sid" ] && touch "$HOME/.claude/state/askuserquestion-$sid.needs"; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Your first tool call MUST be ToolSearch with query select:AskUserQuestion. A PreToolUse hook blocks all other tools until this is done."}}'

cd ~/.claude 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1; files=$(git diff --cached --name-only | paste -sd, - | head -c 200); { echo "--- $(date) ---"; git commit -m "auto-sync: $files"; git push; } >>~/.claude/.sync.log 2>&1; exit 0
